# k3d_manifest (Resource)

Any single Kubernetes object, built in or custom, applied with server-side apply. The content is not checked against the cluster during plan, so a custom resource can share an apply with its CRD, and a mistake in it fails at apply. Refresh only checks that the object exists, so changes made to its contents outside Terraform are not detected. Changing the kind, name, or namespace replaces the object. Creating one that already exists fails: import it instead. For multiple objects, use `for_each`. Import with `<cluster>|<apiVersion>|<kind>|<namespace>|<name>`, leaving the namespace empty for cluster-scoped objects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "k3d_manifest" "gateway" {
  cluster = k3d_cluster.main.id

  manifest = yamlencode({
    apiVersion = "networking.istio.io/v1"
    kind       = "Gateway"
    metadata   = { name = "default", namespace = "istio-system" }
    spec = {
      selector = { istio = "ingressgateway" }
      servers  = [{ port = { number = 80, name = "http", protocol = "HTTP" }, hosts = ["*"] }]
    }
  })

  depends_on = [k3d_istio.mesh]
}

locals {
  documents = [for document in split("\n---\n", file("${path.module}/app.yaml")) : yamldecode(document)]
}

resource "k3d_manifest" "app" {
  for_each = { for object in local.documents : "${object.kind}/${object.metadata.name}" => object }

  cluster  = k3d_cluster.main.id
  manifest = yamlencode(each.value)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) YAML or JSON holding exactly one object. Values in it appear in plans, so use `k3d_secret` for secrets.

### Optional

- `cluster` (String) Cluster to manage the object in, usually `k3d_cluster.<name>.id`, so the object is recreated when the cluster is replaced. Exactly one of `cluster` or `kubeconfig` is required.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig contents, for a cluster that is reached directly and not through Docker. Not recorded as a dependency on the cluster's lifetime, so prefer `cluster` for clusters in the same configuration. It is stored in Terraform state, so use an encrypted state backend.
- `timeout` (String) How long to wait. Defaults to `5m`.
- `wait` (Boolean) Wait for the object to be ready, such as a Deployment finishing its rollout. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `api_version` (String) API version of the object.
- `id` (String) UID of the object.
- `kind` (String) Kind of the object.
- `name` (String) Name of the object.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the object, null if cluster-scoped.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import k3d_manifest.gateway 'demo|networking.istio.io/v1|Gateway|istio-system|default'
```
